title: 1.9 Give a reason and suggest a workable alternative
unit_outcome: Explain a working day, compare two people’s commitments, check assumptions and account for a change of routine.
lesson_title: Give a reason and suggest a workable alternative
sub_lesson_title: Give a reason and suggest a workable alternative
goal: Ask why an option does not work, understand the stated reason and propose an alternative consistent with it.
grammar_function: An alternative must address the reason. The learner follows a cause-and-response chain instead of recognizing a polite refusal.
prerequisite: 1.3 intervals, 1.7 negative information, 1.8 useful follow-ups A1 invitations, Let’s, tired and established alternative exchange 1.4 put on/take off and clothing; 1.7 productive does + base; A1 his/her and hot/cold.
speaking_outcome: Natural because and meaningful phrase boundaries; retain understandable question and response prosody.
